intent: Watches a fresh deploy for a bounded window, drives real user paths against the live URL, hard-stops and escalates the moment a signal goes red, records a verdict artifact, and never attempts a fix itself.

dimensions.name: bounded-watch
dimensions.criterion: A short, bounded watch — probe then poll a defined window, then declare; not an indefinite monitor.

dimensions.name: real-paths
dimensions.criterion: Drives real user paths (not just /health) against the live URL via browse/HTTP.

dimensions.name: red-is-hard-gate
dimensions.criterion: A red signal hard-stops and escalates per policy; it is never logged-and-ignored.

dimensions.name: detect-not-fix
dimensions.criterion: Detects and escalates; recommends rollback but never fixes inside the canary.

dimensions.name: records-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the verdict as run artifact 06d-canary.md.
